questions.question: Fill in the blank: All circles are ____.
questions.explanation: Every circle has the same shape; only the radius changes.
option_feedback: Correct! All circles have the same shape.
Circles of different radii are not the same size, so not congruent.
A bigger circle has a bigger area.
Concentric means having the same centre; circles can be anywhere.

questions.question_gu: ખાલી જગ્યા પૂરો: બધાં વર્તુળો ____ છે.
questions.explanation_hi: हर वृत्त का आकार एक-सा होता है; केवल त्रिज्या बदलती है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: All squares are ____.
questions.explanation: All squares have $90^\circ$ angles and equal sides, so they have the same shape.
option_feedback: Correct! Equal angles and proportional sides.
Squares of different sides are not the same size.
A bigger square has a bigger area.
A bigger square has a bigger perimeter.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: All ____ triangles are similar.
questions.explanation: Every equilateral triangle has all angles $60^\circ$.
option_feedback: Correct! Every equilateral triangle has angles $60^\circ, 60^\circ, 60^\circ$.
Isosceles triangles can have different angles.
Right triangles can have different acute angles, like $30^\circ$ or $45^\circ$.
Scalene triangles can have any angles.

समद्विबाहु त्रिभुजों के कोण अलग हो सकते हैं।

questions.question: Fill in the blanks: Two polygons of the same number of sides are similar, if (a) their corresponding angles are ____ and (b) their corresponding sides are ____.
questions.explanation: Similar polygons have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides.
option_feedback: Correct! Equal angles and sides in the same ratio.
It is the other way round: angles equal, sides proportional.
Equal sides would make them congruent; similar needs only proportional sides.
Corresponding angles must be equal, not supplementary.

questions.question: Give two different examples of a pair of (i) similar figures, (ii) non-similar figures.
answer_steps: (i) Similar: two circles of radii 2 cm and 5 cm; two equilateral triangles of sides 3 cm and 6 cm.
(ii) Non-similar: a square and a rectangle that is not a square; an equilateral triangle and a right triangle.

questions.question: State whether a square of side 1.5 cm and a rhombus of side 3 cm whose angles are not right angles are similar. Give a reason.
answer_steps: The sides are proportional ($\dfrac{1.5}{3}$ for every pair), but the angles of the rhombus are not $90^\circ$.
The corresponding angles are not equal, so they are not similar.

answer_steps_hi: भुजाएँ समानुपाती हैं (हर युग्म के लिए $\dfrac{1.5}{3}$), पर समचतुर्भुज के कोण $90^\circ$ नहीं हैं।
संगत कोण बराबर नहीं हैं, अतः ये समरूप नहीं हैं।
answer_steps_gu: બાજુઓ પ્રમાણમાં છે (દરેક જોડ માટે $\dfrac{1.5}{3}$), પણ સમબાજુ ચતુષ્કોણના ખૂણા $90^\circ$ નથી.
અનુરૂપ ખૂણા સમાન નથી, તેથી તે સમરૂપ નથી.
